ceo.notes: CEO selected for 2024 despite CSV naming another later CEO; this follows local annual report and financial statements. No confirmed research publications, patents, or h-index. Round-2 (2026-07-30): re-fetched material-3-svedeniya-o-kandidatah-v-sd.pdf directly and confirmed the full candidate anketa text verbatim; added 2 missing education entries, 5 missing professional_experience entries (Новая Перспектива, МВМ/МВ Финанс/БТ Холдинг, КэпиталГард, СAO ВСК, ЛК Европлан) and filled qualification_degree on 5 previously-null education entries, all traceable to the same already-cited source. Round-3 quality pass (2026-07-30): independently re-verified all Round-2 additions against fresh direct fetches of material-1-svedeniya-o-kandidatah-v-sd.pdf (29.08.2025) and material-3-svedeniya-o-kandidatah-v-sd.pdf (26.02.2026) — all confirmed verbatim accurate. Added 4 more missing professional_experience entries found in the same re-fetch (2017-2021 board term, Директ Кредит Центр, Техкод, МВМ advisor role from 2025). Applied Broadline Retail GICS to all same-company (ПАО "М.видео") entries and to the МВМ advisor role; classified Директ Кредит Центр as Consumer Finance (confirmed fintech POS-lending platform acquired by M.Video in 2021). Left ООО "МВ Ритейл Инвестиции", the combined МВМ/МВ Финанс/БТ Холдинг entry, ООО "Новая Перспектива" and ООО "ТЕХКОД" GICS null — see research_notes/MVID/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md for reasoning (holding-name ambiguity / unresolved gap).

Round-3 quality pass (2026-07-30): independently re-verified the Round-2 institution correction and MVM-group entry against a second, later primary-source fetch (material-3-svedeniya-o-kandidatah-v-sd.pdf, 26.02.2026) — both confirmed accurate. Added a missing 30.04.2025 board-membership date and classified Natura Siberica (Personal Care Products) and the ПАО "М.видео" 2025 role (Broadline Retail) with GICS. АФК "Система" left GICS-null: it is a large diversified conglomerate holding with no single primary operating business, correctly non-classifiable. The combined ООО "МВМ"/ООО "БТ ХОЛДИНГ"/ООО "МВ ФИНАНС"/ООО "Техкод" entry left GICS-null because it bundles a confirmed retail-operating entity (МВМ) with an entity whose name signals a pure holding structure (БТ ХОЛДИНГ) and an unclear finance/IT-services entity (МВ ФИНАНС, Техкод) — assigning one triple to all four risked mislabeling; see research_notes/MVID/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md.

sources.fact: Round-2 GENUINE INCONSISTENCY (unresolved with certainty, corrected to best-available source): при прямой перепроверке того же URL, уже процитированного для всех 4 записей об образовании Дениса Голышева, документ (материал к ВОСА 29.08.2025) дословно указывает: "Высшее – Институт переподготовки и повышения квалификации сотрудников ФСБ РФ (1996), специализация – юриспруденция" — институт, специализация и год полностью отличаются от прежней записи ("Высшее пограничное командное училище КГБ СССР им. Ф.Э. Дзержинского", 1988, иностранный язык), которая нигде на этом или ином проверенном источнике не находится. Возможные причины: (а) ошибка в round-1 (спутан однофамилец), либо (б) содержимое этого generic URL было заменено М.Видео более новым комплектом материалов между round-1 и этим раундом (типично для страниц IR с несколькими последовательными ВОСА под одним и тем же именем файла). Независимая перепроверка через пресс-релиз detail/4310 не содержит биографии Голышева вовсе, так что второй источник не найден. validation_notes: Processed 15 CSV people for ticker MVID. Checked 2 local documents: annual report and consolidated financial statements. Completed one research round per person, 15 person rounds plus an overview note. CEO for the 2024 context is Билан Ужахов; CSV value for Владислав Бакальчук conflicts with local 2024 documents and was treated as a later 2026 appointment. Local annual report does not disclose the full 2024 Board of Directors composition; later official M.Video materials were used only for identity and biography, not to backdate roles to 2024. Education was not confirmed for Johannes Maria Tolay, Dmitry Pylev, Andrey Skachek, Vladislav Ushakov, Karen Ashrafyan and Sergey Anufriev. Weak or secondary sources were used for Karen Ashrafyan and Sergey Anufriev role confirmation where official biography pages were absent. No confirmed patents, h-index, or peer-reviewed publication profiles were attributed. Main same-name risks were excluded by requiring M.Video, prior employer, role, and date anchors. QUALITY PASS Round-3 (2026-07-30): Step 0 check against git HEAD found no regressions — on-disk file already contained an undocumented Round-2 pass (CEO/Lieb/Golyshev) from earlier the same day, which this round independently re-verified against fresh direct fetches of the underlying PDFs (material-1 29.08.2025, material-3 26.02.2026, Material_1_CD 12.01.2024) and confirmed accurate, not fabricated. Fixed 2 internal desyncs (Kuznetsov IE Business School qualification_degree, MGU physics entry set to "Unknown" per project's own stated policy). Added 12 missing professional_experience/education entries across 5 people (Ужахов x4, Либ board-date, Мохов ООО МАЙ, Щепелин x3, Ярина ACCA+IDA) found via fresh primary-source re-fetches and traceable to already-cited sources. Applied GICS to 20 previously-null professional_experience entries with either high confidence (same-company M.Video-group entries, well-known external companies confirmed via WebFetch/general knowledge) or explicit reasoning documented per-person; left several combined multi-organization or holding-structure entries GICS-null by design (documented). WebSearch quota was exhausted mid-session; several honest-gap follow-ups (Tolay/Pylev/Skachek/Ushakov/Ashrafyan/Anufriev education, UTech, ООО МАЙ, ООО МАРКЕТПЛЕЙС) could not run fresh queries this round and are logged as still-unresolved with the intended queries, for a future pass. Full details in research_notes/MVID/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md.
